verdict.rationale: Verbatim German guidance text was captured from the public elster.de pages (homepage and the Unternehmer info page), which implies the public reading surface returned readable content. No probe explicitly records a keyless fetch with an identified user agent, an HTTP status, or the absence of a bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA. The related ERiC artifact host (esteuer.de) timed out for a keyless client, though that is a developer download host, not the guidance pages. Missing for 10: an explicit keyless-fetch probe of the guidance pages with an identified UA, confirmation of no bot wall/CAPTCHA/JS shell, and coverage beyond the two captured pages.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface

citations.quote: Das Online-Finanzamt ermöglicht es Ihnen, ihre Steuerdaten (zum Beispiel die Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung) vollkommen papierlos abzugeben.
Seit Juli 2026 ermöglicht die App MeinELSTER+ die automatische Erstellung von Steuererklärungen für das Kalenderjahr 2025.
